main_text.l: & situm frequenter ac uarie mutant. Hanc diuer-
sitatem ac uarietatem in singulorum motibus acci-
dere, stata tamen atq; immota lege recurrere ob-
seruationes docent ac conuincunt. Cum uero cer-
orbium perpetuo congruere, ne irregularitas concedatur
hæc φαινό-μενα alij alijs hypothesibus constitutis
& assumptis orbibus eccentricis atq; Epicyclis seu pluribus
extruunt, quibus uarietatis huius causas ostendunt, quas
artificum opera proponunt & explicant, inde studiosi petant.

page.notes: Greek line "τέλος, θεῷ δόξα." is printed in a stylised form; the transcription follows the letters as read. The stamp and the URL http://rcin.org.pl at the foot were omitted as not printed matter of the book.
